Apply d/dtheta to F and evaluate at theta=z, using d/dtheta F(theta)=polygamma(1,theta), to obtain the second summand. The given expression is the sum of these two images.
required_assumptions: F(theta)=polygamma(0,theta) is differentiable in theta at z
hypotheses.rationale: The two summands are consecutive polygamma orders and are related by differentiation with respect to the argument.
